title: 🖐️ Retro Player / Eye Frame Rework

current_candidate.summary: Player V12 remains published but its eye framing/cropping was rejected and must not be treated as accepted.

isolation_lab.summary: V15 is the first eye-lab build produced through a measured normalization pipeline before animation: split → mask → measure → semantic anchor → fixed-canvas translation → residual correction → QA → export.

open_feedback: Verify the standalone blink no longer jumps or drifts frame to frame.
Verify the eye remains centered through the full blink.
Do not reintegrate into Player or restore the pupil until this isolated aligned blink is accepted.
